title: Ambulance dispatch
goal: Show dispatch, field response, and handover.

rubric.must: Available units visibly return before Ambulance is dispatched.
A par frame separates pre-alert and patient assessment.
An opt frame encloses destination confirmation.
Ambulance has a self-message for Assess patient.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Image 1 visibly satisfies all five rules, while Image 2 omits the required sequence messages, frames, and note.
